dog.description_text:
What my friends at ACC say about me:

My history is a mystery and my friends here do not know much about me yet!

I love getting pets and - you guessed it - snuggles!

I'm ready to learn! I need a patient person who has the time to work on training with me.

I am excitable and energetic! I will need positive outlets for my energy!

I would do best in a home with only adult humans.

A Volunteer writes: The sweetness of this girl could make your teeth ache, but oh, the fullness of your heart in her company! Atlas loves to give gentle hugs, kind snuggles and asks so little other than to be shown half of the affection she gives. Atlas has lived with other dogs and is a joy to walk on the leash to the park, where she wags her tail at every passing creature but never leaves her walker's side. Even when she arrived at the shelter she was described as "wiggly," and we can only imagine how much wagging and wiggling she has in her future!
dog.name: Atlas
